newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-IVIC STILL ON THE RUN AFTER FIGHT WITH TV GIRLFRIEND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IVIC STILL ON THE RUN AFTER FIGHT WITH TV GIRLFRIEND.

text.p: Yugoslav international striker Ilia Ivic, who plays for Greek league leaders Olympiakos, was in hiding for the fifth day on Tuesday after being charged for assaulting his girlfriend.

Club officials said Ivic had talked on the phone with Olympiakos's Yugoslav coach Dusan Bayevic and that he was continuing treatment on a knee injury that means he can't play for at least another month.
"He told Bayevic that he had a simple fight with his girlfriend and that the Greek press had exaggerated the incident," a club official told Reuters.

Police said on Monday that Ivic had allegedly punched Eleni Petroulaki -- Greece's best known gymnast with her own aerobics show on television -- several times in the face early on Friday in a row after she told him she wanted to end their affair.
Doctors said Petroulaki had been treated for head injuries and bruises could clearly be seen on her face as she left hospital on Monday.
Ivic has since disappeared although an arrest warrant -- aiming to bring him to an immediate trial -- expired on Sunday night. A new court date would be set probably for next month.
Bayevic condemmed the attack on Monday, but said the club would not comment on matters relating to Ivic's personal life.
Olympiakos meanwhile beat Kalamata 4-1 on Monday night without Ivic to move six points clear of Panathinaikos at the top of the table.
